text: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid ordinary foreign passport, in good physical and mental health. 2. Sufficient financial resources; no criminal record. 3. Applicants who meet the following conditions are eligible to apply as international students: (1) Applicants who emigrated from mainland China, Hongkong, Taiwan or Macao, and have obtained a foreign nationality. (2) Applicants who acquired a foreign nationality at the time of birth, and whose parents (either or both) hold Chinese nationality (nationalities) and reside abroad. --- International applicants in the above situation must fulfill both two conditions following: ① Applicants must have held a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years (inclusive), which means having acquired a foreign nationality before May 1, 2022. ② Applicants must have lived outside mainland China/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan for at least two years during the period from May 1, 2022 to April 30, 2026 (according to the entry and exit record, if the applicant has stayed outside mainland China/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan for nine months or longer period during one year, it is equivalent to one year). 4. Age Requirements: Self-funded applicants: be at least 16 years old and under the age of 35. 5. Educational Background: have obtained a graduation certificate of higher secondary school, or its international equivalent, qualified for university entrance. 6. Language Proficiency: For Chinese-taught programs: a minimum HSK Level 4 Certificate (score ≥180) & provide HSKK score. Important Note: To enroll in an undergraduate program at Donghua University, applicants must possess genuine Chinese proficiency equivalent to HSK Level 5 (with a minimum score of 180) or higher. Higher scores are strongly preferred. An HSK Level 4 score (above 180) or an HSK Level 5 score (below 180) can only be used for application purposes and is only valid during the application stage. If a conditional offer is received, a newly obtained HSK Level 5 certificate (with a score above 180) must be submitted to the university before the enrollment & registration. Failure to do so will result in the inability to register and commence undergraduate studies. ① The test date on the certificate must be on or after September 1, 2024. ② Applicants whose higher secondary school curriculum and teaching-related activities were conducted entirely in Chinese may be exempted from submitting an HSK certificate. However, a certificate issued and officially stamped/signed by the school confirming that all courses and teaching activities were conducted entirely in Chinese must be provided. ③ Applicants who graduated from a full Chinese-medium high school program before September 1, 2024, must submit the required HSK certificate and HSKK score report as specified above. 7. CSCA Score Report (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) For Chinese-taught Programs: Mandatory subjects are Professional Chinese (Humanities) or Professional Chinese (STEM), as well as Mathematics.
